differences.current_text: PAUL and Sylvanus and Timothy, to the church of the Thessalonians, which is in God our Father and our Lord Yeshua the Messiah:
differences.source_text: PAUL and Sylvanus and Timothy, to the church of the Thessalonians, which is in God our Father and our Lord Jesus the Messiah:

differences.current_text: Grace be with you, and peace, from God our Father, and from our Lord Yeshua the Messiah.
differences.source_text: Grace be with you, and peace, from God our Father, and from our Lord Jesus the Messiah.

differences.current_text: and you, who are the troubled, he will vivify, with us, at the manifestation of our Lord Yeshua the Messiah from heaven, with the host of his angels;
differences.source_text: and you, who are the troubled, he will vivify, with us, at the manifestation of our Lord Jesus the Messiah from heaven, with the host of his angels;

differences.current_text: when he will execute vengeance, with the burning of fire, on them that know not God, and on them that acknowledge not the gospel of our Lord Yeshua the Messiah.
differences.source_text: when he will execute vengeance, with the burning of fire, on them that know not God, and on them that acknowledge not the gospel of our Lord Jesus the Messiah.

differences.current_text: so that the name of our Lord Yeshua the Messiah, may be glorified in you, (and) ye also in him; according to the grace of God, and of our Lord Yeshua the Messiah.
differences.source_text: so that the name of our Lord Jesus the Messiah, may be glorified in you, (and) ye also in him; according to the grace of God, and of our Lord Jesus the Messiah.

differences.current_text: But we entreat of you, my brethren, in regard to the coming of our Lord Yeshua the Messiah, and in respect to our being congregated unto him,
differences.source_text: But we entreat of you, my brethren, in regard to the coming of our Lord Jesus the Messiah, and in respect to our being congregated unto him,

differences.current_text: then at length will that evil One be revealed; whom our Lord Yeshua will consume by the breath of his mouth, and will bring to naught by the visibility of his advent.
differences.source_text: then at length will that evil One be revealed; whom our Lord Jesus will consume by the breath of his mouth, and will bring to naught by the visibility of his advent.

differences.current_text: For unto these it was, that God called you by our preaching; that ye might be the glory to our Lord Yeshua the Messiah.
differences.source_text: For unto these it was, that God called you by our preaching; that ye might be the glory to our Lord Jesus the Messiah.

differences.current_text: And may our Lord Yeshua the Messiah himself, and God our Father, who hath loved us, and given us everlasting consolation and a good hope through his grace,
differences.source_text: And may our Lord Jesus the Messiah himself, and God our Father, who hath loved us, and given us everlasting consolation and a good hope through his grace,

differences.current_text: And we enjoin upon you, my brethren, in the name of our Lord Yeshua the Messiah, that ye withdraw from every brother who walketh wickedly, and not according to the precepts which ye received from us.
differences.source_text: And we enjoin upon you, my brethren, in the name of our Lord Jesus the Messiah, that ye withdraw from every brother who walketh wickedly, and not according to the precepts which ye received from us.

differences.current_text: Now such persons, we command and exhort, by our Lord Yeshua the Messiah, that in quietness they work, and eat their own bread.
differences.source_text: Now such persons, we command and exhort, by our Lord Jesus the Messiah, that in quietness they work, and eat their own bread.

differences.current_text: The grace of Yeshua the Messiah be with you all, my brethren. Amen.
differences.source_text: The grace of Jesus the Messiah be with you all, my brethren. Amen.
